name: a single exit is treated as an enumerable set
expect: a single-exit function is not a container

name: a nested scope's exits are counted as the outer function's
edits:
if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.Lambda)):
            continue                                   # a nested scope owns its own exits
expect: a nested function's exits are NOT the outer function's

name: a container the diff touched ENTIRELY is advised on anyway
edits:
if len(hit) == len(members):
            continue            # every member was touched — there is nothing left to prompt
expect: a container touched ENTIRELY is silent

name: a container the diff never touched is advised on anyway
edits:
if not hit:
            continue            # nothing here was touched — not this diff's business
expect: a container touched NOWHERE is silent

name: one if/elif chain is reported once per arm
edits:
if isinstance(node, ast.If) and node in elifs:
            continue
expect: …and reported once, not once per arm

name: `else:` + an indented `if` is fused into the parent chain
expect: `else:` + an indented `if` is TWO containers, not one fused chain

name: a peer is recorded as its head LINE rather than its RANGE
expect: touching the VALUE inside a multi-line exit still finds its peers

name: unparseable source raises instead of refusing
expect: …and it REFUSES rather than raising — the ratchetable form

name: a git failure is spelled the same way as a clean diff
expect: git not answering — bad ref OR no repo — reports CANNOT RUN (None), never a clean diff

name: a try with ONE handler is treated as an enumerable set
expect: a try with ONE handler is not a container

name: a chain of ONE arm is treated as an enumerable set
expect: a chain of ONE arm is not a container

name: a bare `return` counts as a value-returning exit
expect: a bare `return` is not a value-returning exit

name: `--diff REF` diffs the REF itself, charging the branch for master's changes
expect: `--diff REF` resolves the MERGE BASE first

name: a file git could not diff is reported and then the run exits 0 anyway
expect: a file git could not diff makes the whole run exit 2

name: the footer counts files LISTED rather than files examined
expect: …and the footer counts examined files, not listed ones

name: the diff is fetched with context, so parse_hunks' body walk drifts
expect: …via `git diff -U0`, which is what makes the body parse exact
